description: Test data policy contract — validates PII prohibition, snapshot governance, DB isolation, deterministic seeds, and factory framework configuration

rules.description: piiPolicy.allowRealData must not be true; source must not be a production copy
isolation.strategy must be one of: transaction-rollback, per-test-db, per-suite-db, truncate-between, in-memory, docker-per-suite
snapshotPolicy required when strategy includes 'snapshots'; must have maxAgeDays ≤ 90 and sanitized: true
seed.value or seed.strategy required when strategy includes 'factories' or 'generated'
